description: Image Description: The image features a toothbrush with a predominantly white handle that has red striped grips. The bristles of the toothbrush are arranged in three colors: red, white, and blue. The toothbrush is resting horizontally on a wooden ledge. Behind it, there is a mesh or netted surface through which an outdoor scene with blurred greenery and a pathway is visible. The lighting suggests daylight, as natural light is coming through the mesh.
